gloss: to end one's life; to take a life

definitions.gloss: to end one's life; to take one's own life; to kill
definitions.explanation: To bring about death, either one's own or another's. When used reflexively ({自|みずか}ら{命|いのち}を{絶|た}つ), it is a euphemism for suicide. Can also refer to killing another person or creature.

examples.japanese: {自|みずか}ら{命|いのち}を{絶|た}った。
{若|わか}くして{命|いのち}を{絶|た}たれた。
examples.english: His life was cut short at a young age.

examples.japanese: {多|おお}くの{兵士|へいし}が{戦場|せんじょう}で{命|いのち}を{絶|た}たれた。
examples.english: Many soldiers lost their lives on the battlefield.

notes:
A literary and euphemistic expression for death. The construction {自|みずか}ら{命|いのち}を{絶|た}つ is a standard euphemism for suicide in Japanese news reporting and formal contexts.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {自|みずか}ら{命|いのち}を{絶|た}つ: to take one's own life (suicide)
- {命|いのち}を{絶|た}たれる: to have one's life taken (passive; killed by another)
- {若|わか}い{命|いのち}を{絶|た}つ: to end a young life

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {自殺|じさつ}する: to commit suicide — the direct, clinical term
- {命|いのち}を{落|お}とす: to lose one's life — neutral; does not imply intent
- {命|いのち}を{奪|うば}う: to take someone's life — implies forceful killing by another
